pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start with a 14-day free trial. Upgrade or switch plans anytime.

items.q: Do you use the official WhatsApp API?
items.a: Yes. The platform connects through Meta's official WhatsApp Business Cloud API using your own number and business account.

items.q: Can the AI assistant make mistakes?
items.a: It is strictly constrained to reply using only your configured FAQ, services, and business rules, handing off to your team when unsure.

items.q: Is my customer data isolated from other businesses?
items.a: Yes. Each tenant has an entirely separate, isolated workspace for customers, conversations, and settings.

items.q: Can my team take over a conversation?
items.a: Yes. An agent can jump in at any time, which automatically pauses the AI until you choose to resume it.

items.q: Is a credit card required for the trial?
items.a: No. The 14-day trial does not require any payment information.

automation.title: Auto-replies
automation.intro: These rules trigger before the AI assistant, as long as no human team member has taken over. Use {{name}} for customer's first name.
automation.name: Rule name
automation.keywordsHint: Matches full words, ignoring case and accents.
automation.hoursHint: Business local time. Can span past midnight (e.g. 18:00 → 07:00).
automation.order: Order: keyword, then away, then welcome. Away messages are sent at most once every 12 hours per conversation.
automation.stopNote: Customers who reply STOP are excluded from campaigns (START to opt back in).

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.intro: Send messages to your customer list. Customers who replied STOP are excluded. Use {{name}} for first name.

campaigns.confirmStart: Send this campaign now? Each message counts toward your monthly quota.

campaigns.running: Sending in progress… keep this page open.
campaigns.blockedMESSAGE_LIMIT_REACHED: Monthly message quota reached: campaign is paused.
campaigns.blockedWHATSAPP_NOT_CONNECTED: WhatsApp is not connected: campaign is paused.
campaigns.caveat: With Meta's official API, free-form messages are delivered only if the customer contacted you within 24 hours (otherwise an approved template is required). Evolution API allows direct messaging, but send in moderate batches.
